experiment_data.hypothesis: TCR's CF elimination generalizes across datasets (DocRED 96 rels, Mistral, 70B) and fine-tuning settings, but effectiveness is inversely correlated with mean schema constraint tightness (κ̄): higher κ̄ (more restrictive schemas like DocRED) produces more fundamental conflicts where no single entity type satisfies all relational contexts, causing DR to increase when CF is forcibly resolved.
